title: An intrinsically disordered transcription activation domain alters the DNA binding affinity and specificity of NFκB p50/RelA
authors: Hannah E.R. Baughman; Dominic Narang; Wei Chen; Amalia C. Villagrán Suárez; Joan Lee; Maxwell Bachochin; Tristan R. Gunther; Peter G. Wolynes; Elizabeth A. Komives
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物物理实验研究NFκB p50/RelA的无序转录激活域对DNA结合亲和力与特异性的调控，虽非AI/物理模拟方法，但聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，对理解TF-DNA结合动态与特异性建模有重要参考价值。
abstract: Many transcription factors contain intrinsically disordered transcription activation domains (TADs), which mediate interactions with co-activators to activate transcription. Historically, DNA-binding domains and TADs have been considered as modular units, but recent studies have shown that TADs can influence DNA binding. We biophysically characterized the NFκB p50/RelA heterodimer including the RelA TAD and investigated the TAD’s influence on NFκB-DNA interactions. In solution the RelA TAD is disordered but compact, with helical tendency in two regions that interact with co-activators. The presence of the TAD increased the stoichiometry of NFκB-DNA complexes containing promoter DNA sequences with tandem κB recognition motifs by promoting the binding of NFκB dimers in excess of the number of κB sites. We measured the binding affinity of p50/RelA for DNA containing tandem κB sites and single κB sites. While the presence of the TAD enhanced the binding affinity of p50/RelA for all κB sequences tested, it increased the affinity for non-specific DNA sequences by over 10-fold, leading to an overall decrease in specificity for κB DNA sequences. Our results reveal a novel function of the RelA TAD in promoting binding to non-consensus DNA previously observed by in vivo studies of NFκB-DNA binding in response to strong inflammatory signals.
abstract_zh: 许多转录因子含有内在无序的转录激活结构域（TADs），这些结构域通过介导与共激活因子的相互作用来激活转录。历史上，DNA结合结构域和TADs被视为模块化单元，但近期研究表明TADs能影响DNA结合。我们对包含RelA TAD的NFκB p50/RelA异二聚体进行了生物物理表征，并研究了该TAD对NFκB-DNA相互作用的影响。在溶液中，RelA TAD呈无序但紧凑的状态，在与共激活因子相互作用的两个区域具有螺旋倾向。TAD的存在通过促进NFκB二聚体结合超过κB位点数量，增加了含有串联κB识别基序的启动子DNA序列的NFκB-DNA复合物的化学计量比。我们测量了p50/RelA对含有串联κB位点和单个κB位点的DNA的结合亲和力。虽然TAD的存在增强了p50/RelA对所有测试的κB序列的结合亲和力，但它将非特异性DNA序列的亲和力提高了超过10倍，导致对κB DNA序列的特异性整体下降。我们的结果揭示了RelA TAD在促进与非共有序列DNA结合方面的新功能，这一现象此前在强炎症信号响应下的NFκB-DNA结合体内研究中已被观察到。
